# mtncloud_archive_files (Data Source)

Lists the files and folders in one folder of an archive (Tools > Archives), or every file under it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_archive_files" "reports" {
  archive   = "acme-exports"
  folder    = "reports"
  recursive = true
}

output "reports" {
  value = [for f in data.mtncloud_archive_files.reports.files : f.path if !f.is_directory]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archive` (String) The archive, by name. Set this or `archive_id`.
- `archive_id` (String) The archive, by ID. Set this or `archive`.
- `folder` (String) The folder, for example `reports/2026`. Leave it out for the top of the archive. A folder that doesn't exist has no files.
- `recursive` (Boolean) List every file under the folder, in all its subfolders, instead of what is in the folder itself.

### Read-Only

- `files` (Attributes List) The files and folders, sorted by path. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `id` (String) `<archive_id>:<folder>`.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Read-Only:

- `content_type` (String) Its content type.
- `id` (String) The file's ID (`mtncloud_archive_file_link.file_id`).
- `is_directory` (Boolean) Whether it is a folder.
- `last_updated` (String) When it was last written (RFC 3339).
- `name` (String) Its name.
- `path` (String) Its whole path in the archive.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Its size in bytes.
